title: Uber: Surge Pricing, Notifications, and Driver Allocation
description: Add dynamic surge pricing, real-time notifications, and optimized driver allocation.

data.text: Add surge pricing during high demand, push notifications for ride status, and an allocation algorithm that minimizes rider wait time.

data.title: SurgePricing and NotificationService
Why surge pricing works
data.text: Surge pricing balances supply and demand dynamically. Higher prices attract more drivers and discourage casual rides, restoring equilibrium faster than fixed pricing.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Surge multiplier is demand/supply ratio per zone
Driver allocation considers ETA, rating, and proximity
Separate pricing so it can A/B test multipliers
data.takeaway: Uber is a marketplace. Surge pricing and smart allocation are the invisible forces that keep supply and demand balanced.
